description: Use this when time has passed since a search or a work’s detail answered — the buyer came back later, or is weighing several works — to re-check whether specific impressions can still be bought before offering them. Each work here is unique or from a small edition, so an impression can sell at any time: never offer one as available from an old answer. A search’s offers and get_artwork say what can be bought as they answer, and the checkout checks again itself, so no call is needed between them and the checkout.
name: check_availability
title: Check availability
